errors.evidence: Description states error is approximately 0.4 at rank 64, but the figure shows it is closer to 0.3.
The description claims an increase in generalization errors with higher ranks; however, at rank 16 the value remains the same as rank 4.
The description states ticks on the x-axis are at intervals of 12, while they are actually at 12, 16, 64, and 256.
The description fails to mention the presence of vertical error bars.
